tracks.desc: Under-the-hood mechanics of attention mechanisms, low-latency inference, context retrieval pipelines, model quantization, and autonomous multi-agent loops.

modules.title: 01. Attention Mechanisms & Transformer Runtime Math
modules.summary: Mathematical breakdown of Scaled Dot-Product Attention, KV-caching, and GPU VRAM footprint formulas.
content: At the core of modern autoregressive architectures (LLaMA 3, Mistral, GPT-4) is the attention calculation:
Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q * K^T) / sqrt(d_k)) * V
Where Q is Query, K is Key, and V is Value. sqrt(d_k) prevents magnitude saturation.
